source: Pew Research Center. 2015 Survey of U.S. Catholics and Family Life, fielded May 5-June 7, 2015.
method: Population is respondents who are Catholic by religion (RELIG=2), broken out by how often they attend religious services (ATTEND), collapsed into the survey's own three-bucket grouping (weekly or more; monthly or yearly; seldom or never). Share saying the Catholic Church should (Q.J31e: "Allow divorced Catholics who remarry without getting an annulment to receive Communion"); don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT variable.
